summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint for VulnHunter OS: An advanced bug bounty operating system and vulnerability research workbench for Android Termux. Integrates native Termux OS alerts and daemon execution, automated bug bounty policy triage (filtering ineligible noise), vulnerability chaining synthesis, interactive CVSS v3.1 calculator, multi-method reproduction generators (cURL, Python 3, raw HTTP), and HackerOne/Bugcrowd/Corporate report builders.
